211	/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
212	place 0. -/
213	def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
214

217	example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide

244	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →

46	/-- K1: layout of the leaves. The leaf `l` occupies the byte range `L l` of an MM-02 allocation:
47	its identity `alloc`, an offset `off` and a size `len` (an MM-02.4 place). The layout fixes no
48	ABI, no type alignment and no order of fields. It is a parameter of an execution, defined on

53	(a) the leaves of one root place are in one allocation; (b) two distinct leaves in one allocation
54	have disjoint ranges (`RangeDisjoint`, MM-02.2); (c) the range of every leaf lies within its
55	allocation, which is registered (MM-02.B, spatial containment). (d) No size is bounded below: a
56	range may be empty, so a shape of one leaf may have size zero. No other hypothesis. -/
57	structure LayoutWF (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop where
58	  sameAlloc : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,

61	    (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc → MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len
62	  within : ∀ l < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l →
63	    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size

78	/-- K3: the owner `h` of a root is a frame that is no longer on the stack `F`: the root died by

80	def FrameGone (F : Frames) : Holder → Prop
81	  | .frame f => f ∉ F
82	  | .place _ => False

87	/-- K2: deallocation token of the allocation of a root owned by `h`: the token `tok f` proper to
88	the frame `f` when `h` is the frame `f`; none is fixed for a root owned by a place. -/
89	def tokOf (tok : Nat → Nat) : Holder → Option Nat
90	  | .frame f => some (tok f)
91	  | .place _ => none

93	/-- K3, the decidable part of the relation of representation between an MM-03 state `s3` and an
94	MM-02 state `s2`, for the layout `L`, the frame tokens `tok`, the provider tokens `ptok` and the
95	ghost `provOf` (L4: a root allocated by `alloc` ↦ its provider):
96	- `lwf`: `LayoutWF` (K1);
97	- `inj`: two distinct root places are in distinct allocations (K2: a root corresponds to an
98	  allocation; a part to a sub-range of the allocation of its root, by `LayoutWF.sameAlloc`);
99	- `tokens`: the allocation of a root owned by the frame `f` has the token `tok f` (K2);
100	- `provTokens`: the allocation of a root allocated from the provider `pr` has the token `ptok pr`
101	  (L4);
102	- `live`: every usable root has its allocation live (K3);
103	- `init`: every `Init` leaf has all its bytes initialised (K3; L3: a `Moved` or `Uninit` leaf
104	  imposes nothing);
105	- `freed`: a root dead by `free` has its allocation dead (K3);
106	- `exited`: a root dead by the exit of its frame has its allocation dead (K3);
107	- `leaked`: a root owned by a place, not usable and not freed keeps its allocation live (K3 for a
108	  root dead by `endUse`; L5 for owned storage that dies with a freed root or with its frame).
109	It does not read the contracts `K` (L3). -/
110	structure ReprB (tok ptok : Nat → Nat) (provOf : Nat → Option Nat) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3)
111	    (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop where
112	  lwf : LayoutWF L s3 s2
113	  inj : ∀ r < s3.P.length, ∀ r' < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' →
114	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, ∀ l' ∈ footprint s3.P r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc
115	  tokens : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl =>
116	    OptP (tokOf tok pl.owner) (fun d => ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
117	      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc (·.freeAuth = some d)) True) True
118	  provTokens : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (provOf r) (fun pr =>
119	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, AllocP s2 (L l).alloc (·.freeAuth = some (ptok pr))) True
120	  live : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
121	    LiveAlloc s2 (L l).alloc
122	  init : ∀ l < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →
123	    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len
124	  freed : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.freed r = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
125	    DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc
126	  exited : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl => FrameGone s3.F pl.owner)
127	    False → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc
128	  leaked : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → ¬ s3.Usable r → s3.freed r = false →
129	    OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl => pl.owner.isPlace = true) False → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,

165	/-! ## Sequences of MM-02 operations (MM-02.H, K4, K5) -/
166	
167	/-- An MM-02 operation with its arguments (MM-02.H): read, write, deallocation, allocation. -/
168	inductive Op2 where
169	  | read (ac : MM02.Access)
170	  | write (ac : MM02.Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
171	  | dealloc (id auth : Nat)
172	  | alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat)
173	
174	/-- Effect of an operation of outcome `ok` (MM-02.H.2): a read leaves the state unchanged. -/
175	def Op2.eff : Op2 → MM02.State → MM02.State
176	  | .read _, s => s
177	  | .write ac w, s => s.write ac w
178	  | .dealloc id _, s => s.dealloc id
179	  | .alloc sp b sz al fa, s => s.alloc sp b sz al fa
180	
181	/-- State reached by a sequence of operations of outcome `ok`. -/
182	def exec : MM02.State → List Op2 → MM02.State
183	  | s, [] => s
184	  | s, o :: os => exec (o.eff s) os
185	
186	/-- `p s o` holds for each operation `o` of the sequence, in the state `s` where it runs. -/
187	def Along (p : MM02.State → Op2 → Prop) : MM02.State → List Op2 → Prop
188	  | _, [] => True
189	  | s, o :: os => p s o ∧ Along p (o.eff s) os
190	
191	instance decAlong (p : MM02.State → Op2 → Prop) [h : ∀ s o, Decidable (p s o)] :
192	    (s : MM02.State) → (os : List Op2) → Decidable (Along p s os)
193	  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
194	  | s, o :: os => @instDecidableAnd _ _ (h s o) (decAlong p (o.eff s) os)
195	
196	/-- The operation `o` has the outcome `ok` in `s` for its relation (MM-02.H.1): `ReadStep`,
197	`WriteStep`, `DeallocStep` or `AllocStep`. -/
198	def OpOk (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec)
199	    (s : MM02.State) : Op2 → Prop
200	  | .read ac => ∃ v, MM02.ReadStep ObR ac s (.ok v)
201	  | .write ac w => MM02.WriteStep ObW ac w s (.ok (s.write ac w))
202	  | .dealloc id au => MM02.DeallocStep C id au s (.ok (s.dealloc id))
203	  | .alloc sp b sz al fa => MM02.AllocStep sp b sz al fa s (.ok (s.alloc sp b sz al fa))
204	
205	/-- R6 (MM-03.3 §9.2): every operation of the sequence has the outcome `ok` in the state where it
206	runs, the compatibility `C` and the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` fixed for the execution. -/
207	abbrev AllOk (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) :
208	    MM02.State → List Op2 → Prop :=
209	  Along (OpOk C ObR ObW)

211	/-- K5: the decidable part `dec` of the obligation of a read or a write (alignment of the access,
212	validity of the representation; MM-02.B.4, B.6, C.4, C.5), in the state `s` where it runs. -/
213	def Op2.Dec (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) (s : MM02.State) : Op2 → Prop
214	  | .read ac => ObR.dec s ac
215	  | .write ac w => ObW.dec s ac w
216	  | _ => True

218	/-- K5: `dec` holds for each read and write of the sequence, in the state where it runs. An
219	explicit parametric hypothesis, never instantiated by `True` in a theorem. -/
220	abbrev DecAlong (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) :
221	    MM02.State → List Op2 → Prop :=
222	  Along (Op2.Dec ObR ObW)

224	/-! ## Placement of new allocations (K2) -/
225	
226	/-- K2: geometry of a new allocation: address space, size, alignment. -/
227	structure Geom where
228	  space : Nat
229	  size : Nat
230	  align : Nat
231	
232	/-- K2: `Placement`, the choice of the base address of a new allocation of geometry `g` in the
233	MM-02 state `s`. -/
234	abbrev Placement := MM02.State → Geom → Nat
235	
236	/-- K2: obligation of a placement, `AllocPre` (MM-02.2, création brute: freshness, alignment,
237	no overlap with a live allocation), in every state with fresh identities (`WF`, MM-02.A), for every
238	valid alignment. -/
239	def PlacementOK (pl : Placement) : Prop :=
240	  ∀ s g, MM02.WF s → 0 < g.align → MM02.Pow2 g.align →
241	    MM02.AllocPre s g.space (pl s g) g.size g.align
242	
243	/-- End of the allocation `i` of `s`, `0` if absent. -/
244	def allocEnd (s : MM02.State) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((s.allocs i).map fun a => a.base + a.size).getD 0
245	
246	/-- Largest end of the allocations of identity below `n`. -/
247	def maxEnd (s : MM02.State) : Nat → Nat
248	  | 0 => 0
249	  | n + 1 => max (maxEnd s n) (allocEnd s n)
250	
251	theorem le_maxEnd (s : MM02.State) : ∀ n i, i < n → allocEnd s i ≤ maxEnd s n
252	  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
253	  | n + 1, i, h => by
254	    simp only [maxEnd]
255	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 h with h | rfl
256	    · exact Nat.le_trans (le_maxEnd s n i h) (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
257	    · exact Nat.le_max_right _ _
258	
259	/-- K2: a placement that satisfies its obligation (`topPlacement_ok`): the first multiple of the
260	alignment above the end of every registered allocation. -/
261	def topPlacement : Placement := fun s g => g.align * (maxEnd s s.next / g.align + 1)
262	
263	theorem topPlacement_ok : PlacementOK topPlacement := by
264	  intro s g hwf h0 h2
265	  refine ⟨hwf _ (Nat.le_refl _), h0, h2, Nat.mul_mod_right _ _, fun i a ha _ _ => ?_⟩
266	  have hi : i < s.next := Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
267	  have he : a.base + a.size ≤ maxEnd s s.next := by
268	    have := le_maxEnd s s.next i hi; simpa [allocEnd, ha] using this
269	  have hb := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (maxEnd s s.next) h0
270	  exact MM02.rangeDisjoint_iff.2 (.inl (by simp only [topPlacement]; omega))
271	
272	/-- K2 ("`K.Satisfiable` implique l'existence d'un placement valide"): in MM-02, whose addresses
273	are unbounded naturals (MM-02.2), every allocation of valid alignment has a valid placement in a
274	state with fresh identities, whatever `K.Satisfiable` says. -/
275	theorem placement_exists {s : MM02.State} (hwf : MM02.WF s) (g : Geom) (h0 : 0 < g.align)
276	    (h2 : MM02.Pow2 g.align) : ∃ base, MM02.AllocPre s g.space base g.size g.align :=
277	  ⟨_, topPlacement_ok s g hwf h0 h2⟩
278	
279	/-! ## Accesses and operations attached to MM-03 steps (K4) -/
280	
281	/-- K4: the access to the range of leaf `l` in `s2`: address = base of its allocation + offset,
282	provenance = its allocation (the allocation of its root), length = its size, authority `au`. -/
283	def leafAcc (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (au : MM02.Auth) (l : Nat) : MM02.Access :=
284	  ⟨(((s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map (·.base)).getD 0) + (L l).off, (L l).alloc, (L l).len, au⟩
285	
286	/-- K4 (`read3`): one read of authority `read` per range read. -/
287	def readOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (ls : List Nat) : List Op2 :=
288	  ls.map fun l => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l)
289	
290	/-- K4 (`write3`, `writeShared`): one write of authority `write` per range written, of the bytes
291	`w l` for leaf `l`. -/
292	def writeOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
293	    List Op2 :=
294	  ls.map fun l => .write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)
295	
296	/-- K2, K4 (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, static storage): one allocation per root `i` of `roots`, in
297	order, of geometry `g i`, at the base chosen by `pl` in the current state, with the token `fa`. -/
298	def allocOps (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (fa : Option Nat) :
299	    MM02.State → List Nat → List Op2
300	  | _, [] => []
301	  | s, i :: is => .alloc (g i).space (pl s (g i)) (g i).size (g i).align fa ::
302	      allocOps pl g fa (s.alloc (g i).space (pl s (g i)) (g i).size (g i).align fa) is
303	
304	/-! ## Sequences: composition -/
305	
306	theorem exec_append (s : MM02.State) (os os' : List Op2) :
307	    exec s (os ++ os') = exec (exec s os) os' := by
308	  induction os generalizing s with
309	  | nil => rfl
310	  | cons o os ih => exact ih _
311	
312	theorem along_append {p : MM02.State → Op2 → Prop} {s : MM02.State} {os os' : List Op2} :
313	    Along p s (os ++ os') ↔ Along p s os ∧ Along p (exec s os) os' := by
314	  induction os generalizing s with
315	  | nil => simp [Along, exec]
316	  | cons o os ih => simp only [List.cons_append, Along, exec, ih, and_assoc]
317	
318	theorem exec_wf : ∀ (ops : List Op2) (s : MM02.State), MM02.WF s → MM02.WF (exec s ops)
319	  | [], _, h => h
320	  | o :: os, _, h => exec_wf os _ (by
321	      cases o
322	      · exact h
323	      · exact MM02.write_wf h _ _
324	      · exact MM02.dealloc_wf h _
325	      · exact MM02.alloc_wf h _ _ _ _ _)
326	
327	/-! ## Allocations kept by a step of MM-02 -/
328	
329	/-- `s'` keeps every allocation of `s` with its address space, base, size, alignment, liveness
330	and token, and every initialised byte of it initialised (MM-02.C: a write only initialises;
331	MM-02.A: an allocation leaves the others intact). -/
332	def Dom (s s' : MM02.State) : Prop :=
333	  ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → ∃ a', s'.allocs i = some a' ∧ a'.space = a.space ∧
334	    a'.base = a.base ∧ a'.size = a.size ∧ a'.align = a.align ∧ a'.live = a.live ∧
335	    a'.freeAuth = a.freeAuth ∧ ∀ j, a.bytes j ≠ .uninit → a'.bytes j ≠ .uninit
336	
337	theorem Dom.refl (s : MM02.State) : Dom s s :=
338	  fun _ a h => ⟨a, h, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩
339	
340	theorem Dom.trans {s s' s'' : MM02.State} (h : Dom s s') (h' : Dom s' s'') : Dom s s'' := by

/-! ## Footprints and frames of places (§40) -/

/-- Membership in `footprint(q)` (§40): an existing leaf that is a part of `q`. -/
theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

/-- Footprints depend only on the number of places and on structural parents (§40). -/
theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

/-- The frame of a place is unique (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
theorem FrameOf.det {s : S3} {q f f' : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f) (h' : FrameOf s q f') :
    f = f' := by
  induction h generalizing f' with
  | frame hpl ho => cases h' with
    | frame hpl' ho' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'; rfl
    | place hpl' ho' _ => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
  | place hpl ho _ ih => cases h' with
    | frame hpl' ho' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
    | place hpl' ho' hf' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'; exact ih hf'

/-- A usable place has a frame of the stack (§40, items 2–3). -/
theorem S3.Usable.frameOf {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F := by
  induction h with
  | frame hpl _ ho hf => exact ⟨_, .frame hpl ho, hf⟩
  | place hpl _ ho _ ih => obtain ⟨f, hf, hm⟩ := ih; exact ⟨f, .place hpl ho hf, hm⟩

/-- The frame of a place depends only on the places (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
theorem FrameOf.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) {q f : Nat} :
    FrameOf s' q f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
  ⟨fun h => by induction h with
    | frame hpl ho => exact .frame (hP ▸ hpl) ho
    | place hpl ho _ ih => exact .place (hP ▸ hpl) ho ih,
   fun h => by induction h with
    | frame hpl ho => exact .frame (hP ▸ hpl) ho
    | place hpl ho _ ih => exact .place (hP ▸ hpl) ho ih⟩

/-- `placeFrame` depends only on the places (§40). -/
theorem S3.pframe_congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (q : Nat) : s'.pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, FrameOf.congr hP]

/-- The frame of a holder depends only on the places (§44). -/
theorem S3.hframe_congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (h : Holder) :
    s'.hframe h = s.hframe h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place p => exact S3.pframe_congr hP p

/-- Places with the same owner have the same frame (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
theorem pframe_eq_of_owner {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : s.P[q]? = some pq)
    (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (h : pr.owner = pq.owner) : s.pframe r = s.pframe q := by
  simp only [S3.pframe, pframeF, hq, hr, h]

/-! ## Indexed maps (§72, §73) -/

/-- `mapI` preserves the length (effects of §72 and §73). -/
theorem length_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α), (mapI f i l).length = l.length
  | _, [] => rfl
  | i, _ :: l => by simp [mapI, length_mapI f (i + 1) l]

/-- Element `j` of `mapI f i l` is `f (i + j)` applied to element `j` of `l` (effects of §72 and
§73). -/
theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat), (mapI f i l)[j]? = (l[j]?).map (f (i + j))
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, a :: l, 0 => by simp [mapI]
  | i, a :: l, j + 1 => by
    (releaseEff s a).ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext j; simp only [S3.ancs, release_org hx]

/-! ## Consequences of `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- A part has the owner of every place it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem WF3.ownerOf_aux {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n l r, l < n → partOf s.P l r →
      ∃ pl pr, s.P[l]? = some pl ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ pl.owner = pr.owner
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, l, r, hl, ⟨hlen, hlr⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨pl, hpl⟩ : ∃ pl, s.P[l]? = some pl := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hlen, rfl⟩⟩
    rcases hlr with rfl | hc
    · exact ⟨pl, pl, hpl, hpl, rfl⟩
    cases hpo : parentOf s.P l with
    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hc; simp at hc
    | some p =>
      have hpar : pl.parent = some p := by simp [parentOf, hpl] at hpo; exact hpo
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, -⟩ := hw.places l pl p hpl hpar
      rw [chain_cons hpo hlt] at hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
      · exact ⟨pl, pr, hpl, hpr, ho.symm⟩
      · obtain ⟨pl', pr', hpl', hpr', he⟩ :=
          WF3.ownerOf_aux hw n p r (by omega) ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpr, .inr hc⟩
        rw [hpr] at hpl'; cases hpl'
        exact ⟨pl, pr', hpl, hpr', ho.symm.trans he⟩

/-- A part has the owner of every place it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem WF3.ownerOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r) :
    ∃ pl pr, s.P[l]? = some pl ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ pl.owner = pr.owner :=
  hw.ownerOf_aux (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) h

/-- A part has the death marker of every place it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem WF3.deadOf_aux {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n l r, l < n → partOf s.P l r → s.dead l = s.dead r
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, l, r, hl, ⟨hlen, hlr⟩ => by
    rcases hlr with rfl | hc
    · rfl
    cases hpo : parentOf s.P l with
    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hc; simp at hc
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨pl, hpl⟩ : ∃ pl, s.P[l]? = some pl := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hlen, rfl⟩⟩
      have hpar : pl.parent = some p := by simp [parentOf, hpl] at hpo; exact hpo
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -, hd⟩ := hw.places l pl p hpl hpar
      rw [chain_cons hpo hlt] at hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
      · exact hd.symm
      · exact hd.symm.trans (WF3.deadOf_aux hw n p r (by omega) ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpr, .inr hc⟩)

/-- A part has the death marker of every place it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem WF3.deadOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r) :
    s.dead l = s.dead r :=
  hw.deadOf_aux (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) h

/-- A structural parent exists and precedes its child (§49.2). -/
theorem WF3.parent_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {i o : Nat} (h : parentOf s.P i = some o) :
    o < i ∧ o < s.P.length := by
  simp only [parentOf] at h
  cases hp : s.P[i]? with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; cases h
  | some pl =>
    rw [hp] at h
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -⟩ := hw.places i pl o hp h
    exact ⟨hlt, lt_of_getElem? hpr⟩

/-- The current frame of a nonempty stack belongs to it (§39, §49.1). -/
theorem top_mem {s : S3} (h : s.F ≠ []) : s.top ∈ s.F := by
  unfold S3.top; cases hF : s.F with
  | nil => exact absurd hF h
  | cons f F => simp

/-! ## Usability (§40) -/

/-- Usability depends only on places, stack and death markers: a smaller stack and more dead
places give fewer usable places (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.mono {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : ∀ f ∈ s'.F, f ∈ s.F)
    (hd : ∀ q, s'.dead q = false → s.dead q = false) {q : Nat} (h : s'.Usable q) :
    s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | frame hpl hdq ho hf => exact .frame (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho (hF _ hf)
  | place hpl hdq ho _ ih => exact .place (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho ih

/-- Usability depends only on places, stack and death markers (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    {q : Nat} : s'.Usable q ↔ s.Usable q :=
  ⟨S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => hd ▸ h),
   S3.Usable.mono hP.symm (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => by rw [hd]; exact h)⟩

/-- Usability carries over between states with the same places, stack and death markers
(§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_eqs {s s' : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s'.Usable q) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono hP (fun _ h => hF ▸ h) (fun _ h => hd ▸ h) h

/-- Liveness of a holder depends only on places, stack and death markers (§49.8). -/
theorem HolderLive.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (h : Holder) : HolderLive s' h ↔ HolderLive s h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => simp [HolderLive, hF]
  | place p => exact S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd

/-- A place with the owner and the death marker of a usable place is usable (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_same {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pl pr : Place} (h : s.Usable q)
    (hq : s.P[q]? = some pl) (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (ho : pr.owner = pl.owner)
    (hd : s.dead r = s.dead q) : s.Usable r := by
  cases h with
  | frame hpl hdq hof hf =>
    rw [hq] at hpl; cases hpl; exact .frame hr (by rw [hd]; exact hdq) (by rw [ho]; exact hof) hf
  | place hpl hdq hof hu =>
    rw [hq] at hpl; cases hpl; exact .place hr (by rw [hd]; exact hdq) (by rw [ho]; exact hof) hu

/-- A part of a usable place is usable (§40: parts share owner and death marker; §49.2). -/
theorem usable_of_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n r q, r < n → partOf s.P r q → s.Usable q → s.Usable r
  | 0, _, _, h, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, q, hr, ⟨hlen, hrq⟩, hu => by
    rcases hrq with rfl | hc
    · exact hu
    cases hpo : parentOf s.P r with
    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hc; simp at hc
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨pl, hpl, hpar⟩ : ∃ pl, s.P[r]? = some pl ∧ pl.parent = some p := by
        simp only [parentOf] at hpo
        cases h' : s.P[r]? with
        | none => rw [h'] at hpo; cases hpo
        | some pl => rw [h'] at hpo; exact ⟨pl, rfl, hpo⟩
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hd⟩ := hw.places r pl p hpl hpar
      rw [chain_cons hpo hlt] at hc
      have hup : s.Usable p := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
        · exact hu
        · exact usable_of_partOf hw n p q (by omega) ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpr, .inr hc⟩ hu
      exact hup.of_same hpr hpl ho.symm hd.symm

/-- The place containing a usable part is usable (§40: parts share owner and death marker;
§49.2). -/
theorem usable_of_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r)
    (hu : s.Usable l) : s.Usable r := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pr, hpl, hpr, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf h
  exact hu.of_same hpl hpr ho.symm (hw.deadOf h).symm

/-! ## Root places (§40, §49.6, §49.7) -/

/-- A place belongs to at most one root place (§40). -/
theorem rootOf_unique {P : List Place} {l r r' : Nat} (hr : RootPlace P r)
    (hr' : RootPlace P r') (h : partOf P l r) (h' : partOf P l r') : r = r' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hr⟩ := hr; obtain ⟨-, hr'⟩ := hr'
  obtain ⟨-, h | h⟩ := h <;> obtain ⟨-, h' | h'⟩ := h'
  · exact h.symm.trans h'
  · subst h; rw [chain_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
  · subst h'; rw [chain_none hr'] at h; simp at h
  · exact chainF_root _ _ _ _ h hr h' hr'

/-- Every place of a well-formed state is a part of a root place (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem exists_rootPlace {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) : ∀ n q, q < n → q < s.P.length →
    ∃ r, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P q r
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hqn, hq => by
    cases hp : parentOf s.P q with
    | none => exact ⟨q, ⟨hq, hp⟩, hq, .inl rfl⟩
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, hol⟩ := hw.parent_lt hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hor⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw n o (by omega) hol
      refine ⟨r, hr, hq, .inr ?_⟩
      rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
      rcases hor with rfl | hor
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hor

/-- The footprint of a part is within the footprint of the whole (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem footprint_sub {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {q r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P q r) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : l ∈ footprint s.P r := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  refine mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hqr⟩ := h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hlq
  · exact hqr
  · rcases hqr with rfl | hqr
    · exact .inr hlq
    · exact .inr (chain_trans (fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1) (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q
        hlq r hqr)

/-- A decidable property failing somewhere below `n` has a witness below `n` (§40, search for a
leaf). -/
theorem exists_lt_not_of_not_forall {p : Nat → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :
    ∀ n, ¬ (∀ r < n, p r) → ∃ r < n, ¬ p r
  | 0, h => absurd (fun r hr => absurd hr (Nat.not_lt_zero r)) h
  | n + 1, h => by
    by_cases hn : p n
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall n fun h' => h fun r hr => by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hr with hr | rfl
        · exact h' r hr
        · exact hn
      exact ⟨r, by omega, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n, hn⟩

/-- Every place of a well-formed state has a leaf in its footprint (§40, §49.2: parts follow
their parent, so the search for a part without part terminates). -/
theorem exists_mem_footprint {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n q, s.P.length - q < n → q < s.P.length → ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hn, hq => by
    by_cases hleaf : isLeaf s.P q
    · exact ⟨q, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hq, hleaf, hq, .inl rfl⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall _ hleaf
      have hpr : parentOf s.P r = some q := Decidable.of_not_not hpr
      have hlt : ∀ i o, parentOf s.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1
      have hqr := hlt r q hpr
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw n r (by omega) hr
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf', -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
      refine ⟨l, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf', hlP, .inr ?_⟩⟩
      have hrq : q ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) r := by
        rw [chain_cons hpr hqr]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      rcases hlr with rfl | hlr
      · exact hrq
      · exact chain_trans hlt (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) r hlr q hrq

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7) carries over to a state with the same places and no more usable places,
which keeps every active root authority of `s` unchanged. -/
theorem RootHeld.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeld s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hU : ∀ r, s'.Usable r → s.Usable r)
    (hA : ∀ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none →
      s'.A[i]? = some z) : RootHeld s' := by
  intro r hr hu
  rw [hP] at hr
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, hf⟩ := h r hr (hU r hu)
  exact ⟨i, z, pr, hA i z hz za zo, za, zo, zm, by rw [hP]; exact hpr, hh, by rw [hP]; exact hf⟩

/-- `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7) carries over to a state with the same places whose root
authorities are root authorities of `s` with the same footprint and holder. -/
theorem RootHeldConv.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeldConv s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hA : ∀ (x : Nat) (z' : Authority), s'.A[x]? = some z' → z'.origin = none →
      ∃ z, s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z'.footprint = z.footprint ∧
        z'.holder = z.holder) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hr hlr
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzo, hf, hh⟩ := hA x z' hx ho
  rw [hP] at hr hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hpr'⟩ := h x z l r hz hzo (hf ▸ hl) hr hlr
  exact ⟨pr, by rw [hP]; exact hpr, hh.trans hpr'⟩

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6) carries over to a state with the same tree of places, the same origin
chains, the same footprints, and the same root authorities. -/
theorem RootChain.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootChain s) (hlen : s'.P.length = s.P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf s'.P = parentOf s.P) (hanc : ∀ a, s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)
    (hA : ∀ (a : Nat) (y' : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some y' →
      ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y'.footprint = y.footprint)
    (hroot : ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none →
      ∃ z', s'.A[x]? = some z' ∧ z'.origin = none ∧ z'.footprint = z.footprint) :
    RootChain s' := by
  intro a y' l ha hl hleaf
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hf⟩ := hA a y' ha
  have hleaf0 : isLeaf s.P l := by simpa only [isLeaf, hlen, hpar] using hleaf
  obtain ⟨x, z, r, hx, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, hfz⟩ := h a y l hy (hf ▸ hl) hleaf0
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'o, hz'f⟩ := hroot x z hz hzo
  refine ⟨x, z', r, by rw [hanc]; exact hx, hz', hz'o, ?_, ?_, fun l' => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [RootPlace, hlen, hpar] using hr
  · simpa only [partOf, hlen, hpar] using hlr
  · rw [hz'f, footprint_congr hlen hpar]; exact hfz l'

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6) depends only on the skeletons and the tree of places. -/
theorem SameSkel.rootChain {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (hc : RootChain s)
    (hlen : s'.P.length = s.P.length) (hpar : parentOf s'.P = parentOf s.P) : RootChain s' :=
  hc.transport hlen hpar (fun a => by rw [h.ancs])
    (fun a y' ha => by obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := h.get ha; simp [skel] at e; exact ⟨y, hy, e.2.2.1⟩)
    (fun x z hz hzo => by
      obtain ⟨z', hz', e⟩ := h.get' hz; simp [skel] at e
      exact ⟨z', hz', e.2.1.trans hzo, e.2.2.1⟩)

/-! ## Additions of authorities and `WF3` (§49, §50, §51, §60, §61) -/

/-! ## Shape of `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Places after a transfer: owners within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst` (§63,
`ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- Authorities after a transfer: holders within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst`
(§63, `ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the number of places (§63). -/
theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parents (§63). -/
theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A transfer keeps the footprints (§63). -/
theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parts (§63). -/
theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

/-- Membership in the children of a place (§63.2). -/
theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by
      exact ⟨r', by simp [mvTo, hc], corr_partOf hw hd (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc⟩

/-- A holder within `src` moves to a place (§63, `ok` effect). -/
theorem mvTo_place {P : List Place} {src dst : Nat} {h : Holder} (hh : heldIn P src h) :
    ∃ r', mvTo P src dst h = .place r' := by
  cases h with
  | frame _ => exact hh.elim
  | place r => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- After a transfer, a part of `dst` has the owner of `dst` (§40, §49.2, §63). -/
theorem transfer_owner_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    ∃ pd pr, (transferEff s src dst).P[dst]? = some pd ∧
      (transferEff s src dst).P[r']? = some pr ∧ pr.owner = pd.owner := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pd, hpl, hpd, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
  refine ⟨_, _, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpd]; rfl, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl, ?_⟩
  show (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then _ else pl).owner =
    (if heldIn s.P src pd.owner then _ else pd).owner
  rw [ho]; split
  · rfl
  · exact ho

/-- After a transfer, a part of `dst` is usable when `dst` is (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_usable_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable r' := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact hd'.of_same hpd hpr ho (by show s.dead r' = s.dead dst; exact hw.deadOf hr')

/-- After a transfer, a part of `dst` has the frame of `dst` (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

/-- A transfer creates and duplicates no authority: it changes holders only (§63, §53). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [transfer_A_get]

/-- A place usable after a transfer of a usable `src` was usable before (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)
    {q : Nat} (h : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q) : s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        obtain ⟨r', e⟩ := mvTo_place (dst := dst) hh
        simp [e] at ho
      · exact .frame h' hd ho hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        cases hpo : pl.owner with
        | frame f => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
        | place r =>
          rw [hpo] at hh
          exact .place h' hd hpo (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hh hsrc)
      · exact .place h' hd ho ih

/-- A place usable before a transfer stays usable when `dst` is usable after it (§40, §63: places
owned by a part of `src` become owned by a part of `dst`). -/
theorem transfer_usable_fwd {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).Usable q := by
  have hdl : dst < s.P.length := by have := hd'.lt; rwa [transfer_len] at this
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact .frame (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, heldIn]) hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    by_cases hh : heldIn s.P src (.place o)
    · obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hw hdl hh
      exact .place (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, hh, e])
        (transfer_usable_part hw hr' hd')
    · exact .place (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, hh]) ih

/-- L6: parametric encoding of pointers into bytes (spec 11): `enc addr prov i` is the `i`-th byte
of a pointer to the address `addr` with provenance `prov`; `decode` reads an address back. -/
structure PtrEnc where
  enc : Nat → Option Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat
  decode : (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Nat

/-- L6, obligation of the encoding for a pointer to the address `addr` with provenance `prov`:
`decode (enc addr prov)` is `addr`, and every byte carries the provenance `prov`. Stated per
pointer: a `decode` that reads finitely many bytes cannot invert every natural address (finite
addresses, spec 11). -/
def PtrEncAt (pe : PtrEnc) (addr : Nat) (prov : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  pe.decode (pe.enc addr prov) = addr ∧ ∀ i, (pe.enc addr prov i).2 = prov

/-- L6 ("base + off of first leaf"): address of the pointer to the region `rg`: base of the
allocation of the first leaf of the list plus the offset of that leaf. It need not be the first
byte of the region: K1 fixes no order of fields, and a leaf may have size zero (pass-2 report,
(e) 3). -/
def regionAddr (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (rg : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match rg.head? with
  | some l => (((s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map (·.base)).getD 0) + (L l).off
  | none => 0

/-- L6: provenance of the region `rg`: the allocation of its first leaf (none for an empty
region). -/
def regionProv (L : Layout) (rg : List Nat) : Option Nat := rg.head?.map fun l => (L l).alloc

/-- L6, `ptrBytes`: the bytes of a pointer to the region `rg`. -/
def ptrBytes (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (rg : List Nat) :
    Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat :=
  pe.enc (regionAddr s2 L rg) (regionProv L rg)

/-- L6 (`store a p`): one write of the range of the leaf `p` with the bytes of a pointer to the
region covered by `a`. -/
def storeOps (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Op2 :=
  [.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) (ptrBytes pe s2 L (s3.afp a))]

/-- L6 (`issue`, "prov: allocation of arena storage"): the provenance of a block of the arena entry
`i` of `s3`: the allocation of the storage of the arena, read on its first leaf (as `rootAlloc`
reads a root); none for a missing entry. -/
def arenaProv (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (s3.arenas[i]?).map fun ar => (L ((footprint s3.P ar.storage).headD ar.storage)).alloc

/-- L6, the bytes of the pointer to the block `region` of the arena entry `i`: the address of the
region (`regionAddr`) and the provenance of the storage of the arena (`arenaProv`). -/
def issueBytes (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (i : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat :=
  pe.enc (regionAddr s2 L region) (arenaProv L s3 i)

/-- L6 (`issue` on the arena entry `i`): one write of the range of the destination with the bytes of
the pointer to the block; `available` and `issued` are abstract state of the arena entry (library
obligation). -/
def issueOps (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat)
    (dst : Nat) : List Op2 :=
  [.write (leafAcc s2 L .write dst) (issueBytes pe s2 L s3 i region)]

lost nor fabricated: its provenance is the allocation of `l`, which is live, and its address is
the address of `l`, within that allocation. -/
theorem ptr_target {tok ptok : Nat → Nat} {provOf : Nat → Option Nat} {L : Layout} {s3 : S3}

    (hl : rg.head? = some l) :

`p` (pass-2 report, (e) 4); whether `l` holds the first byte of the region, on the layout

invariant of the arenas of MM-03 (`ArenasInv`, true on the reached states), every leaf `l` of the
block of an `ok` `issue` is in the allocation of every leaf of the storage of the arena, and
`arenaProv` is that allocation. -/
theorem issue_prov_storage {k : K} {L : Layout} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} {i via dst : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s3) (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) (hai : ArenasInv s3)

/-- L7: instantiation of `K.DeclaredDisjoint` by the disjointness of the byte ranges of the leaves
of the two regions: every leaf of `r` and every leaf of `r'` are in different allocations or in
disjoint ranges (MM-02.2, `RangeDisjoint`). -/
def ByteDisjoint (L : Layout) (r r' : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ r, ∀ l' ∈ r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc ∨
    MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len

/-- `ddSound_of_layout` (L7; MM-03.3.8, `DDSound`): when every declaration of disjointness of `K`
implies the byte disjointness of the leaves of the two regions (an obligation of the library that
declares it), and the leaves of a declared region have non-empty ranges, `DDSound` holds. The
non-empty ranges are needed: a leaf of size zero (K1 (d)) is byte-disjoint from itself
(`ddSound_of_layout_needs_size`). -/
theorem ddSound_of_layout {k : K} {L : Layout}
    (h : ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ByteDisjoint L r r')
    (hpos : ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, 0 < (L l).len) : DDSound k := by
  intro r r' hd l hl hl'
  rcases h r r' hd l hl l hl' with e | e
  · exact e rfl
  · exact e (L l).off (Nat.le_refl _) (by have := hpos r r' hd l hl; omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
      (by have := hpos r r' hd l hl; omega)

/-- L7: the instantiation itself, `K.DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint L`, satisfies `DDSound` when
every range is non-empty. -/
theorem ddSound_instance (k : K) {L : Layout} (hpos : ∀ l, 0 < (L l).len) :
    DDSound { k with DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint L } :=
  ddSound_of_layout (fun _ _ h => h) fun _ _ _ l _ => hpos l

/-- Counterexample kept (pass-2 report, (e) 1): with a leaf of size zero, allowed by K1 (d), the
instantiation of L7 declares a region disjoint from itself, and `DDSound` fails. -/
theorem ddSound_of_layout_needs_size (k : K) :
    ¬ DDSound { k with DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ } := fun h =>
  h [0] [0] (fun _ _ _ _ => .inr fun _ h1 h2 _ _ => by simp only at h1 h2; omega) 0

/-- The layout of the counterexample satisfies `LayoutWF` on a state with one static leaf and an
allocation of size zero: the failure is under `LayoutWF`, as L7 states it. -/

    (MM02.State.empty.alloc 0 0 0 1 none) := by decide

/-- L7, exactness of the instantiation under `LayoutWF` (K1 (b)): two lists of leaves without
common leaf are byte-disjoint, so an abstraction can declare every pair of regions that share no
leaf. -/
theorem byteDisjoint_of_leaves {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    {r r' : List Nat} (hr : ∀ l ∈ r, l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hr' : ∀ l ∈ r', l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l) (hd : ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') :

  by_cases e : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc

/-! ## Pinned addresses (L8) -/

/-- Pinned leaves stay live (MM-03.3 §3 O15; A8): every leaf of an existing place that is pinned,
dynamically (`pin`) or statically (`K.Pinned`, MM-03.3.8), is usable. -/
def PinnedLive (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < s.P.length, isLeaf s.P l → (s.pin l = true ∨ k.Pinned l) → s.Usable l

/-- A pinned usable leaf stays usable across every `ok` step (MM-03.3 §3 O15: `transfer`, `endUse`,
`free` and `exitFrame` are rejected on pinned leaves; O4.5, O12.4, O13.4, §4 O7.3 (B4)). The other
steps keep or extend the places, the stack and the `dead` flags. -/
    | alloc hs => exact .alloc hr hs
    | store hs => exact .store hr hs
  | newArena hs => exact .newArena hr hs
  | issue hs => exact .issue hr hs
  | reset hs => exact .reset hr hs

/-- L8, the address of a leaf in an MM-02 state: the base of its allocation plus its offset. -/
def leafAddr (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
  (((s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map (·.base)).getD 0) + (L l).off

/-- `pinned_address_stable` (L8; MM-03.3 O15, §9.1.6): for an `ok` step of MM-03 from a reached
state and an MM-02 sequence after which the arrival states are in `Repr` (the sequence of the step,
`r6_*`), every leaf pinned before the step, dynamically or statically (`K.Pinned`), has a live
allocation before and after, and the same address (base + offset). The content is the liveness:
MM-02 models no physical move of an allocation, and the theorem claims nothing about moves. Under
`DDSound k`. -/
theorem pinned_address_stable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {tok ptok : Nat → Nat}
    {provOf provOf' : Nat → Option Nat} {L : Layout} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : MM02.State}
    {ops : List Op2} (hdd : DDSound k) (hr : Reachable k statics s3) (hs : Step k s3 s3')
    (hR : Repr tok ptok provOf L s3 s2) (hR' : Repr tok ptok provOf' L s3' (exec s2 ops)) {l : Nat}

  have hwf := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1
  have hp := reachable_pinnedLive hdd hr
  have hu := hp l hl hlf hpin
  have hu' := step_pinned_usable hwf hp hs l hl hlf hpin
  have hwf' : WF3 s3' := (reachable_invariants hdd (Reachable.ofStep hr hs)).1
  have hlf' := step_isLeaf_old hs hl hlf
  have hl' : l < s3'.P.length := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hl (step_extends hwf hs).1
  have hlive := (live_of_usable_part hwf hR.toReprB hu
    (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hl, hlf, hl, .inl rfl⟩)).mono fun _ h => h.1
  have hlive' := (live_of_usable_part hwf' hR'.toReprB hu'
    (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hl', hlf', hl', .inl rfl⟩)).mono fun _ h => h.1
  refine ⟨hlive, hlive', ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := hlive
  obtain ⟨b, hb, e⟩ := exec_keeps_base ops s2 hR.wf2 _ a ha
  simp only [leafAddr, ha, hb, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, e]

/-! ## R4 (MM-03.3 §9.2) -/

/-- R4 (MM-03.3 §9.2, from `NoDangling`, §2.6): on a reached state of MM-03 in `Repr` with an MM-02
state, no active authority covers a leaf whose MM-02 allocation is dead; the allocation of every
leaf it covers is registered and live. Under `DDSound k`, the hypothesis of the invariants of the
reached states. -/

    {L : Layout} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : MM02.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hr : Reachable k statics s3)
    (hR : Repr tok ptok provOf L s3 s2) :
    ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s3.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint,
      isLeaf s3.P l ∧ ¬ DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc ∧ LiveAlloc s2 (L l).alloc := by
  intro j y hy ya l hl
  obtain ⟨-, hlf, hlive⟩ := covered_live (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1
    (reachable_invariants hdd hr).2.1.nd (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).1 hR.toReprB hy ya
    hl
  refine ⟨hlf, fun hd => ?_, hlive⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hlive
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hlb⟩ := hd
  rw [ha] at hb; cases hb; rw [hla] at hlb; cases hlb

/-! ## Exclusive bytes (MM-03.3 §9.1.8) -/

/-- `exclusive_bytes` (MM-03.3 §2.2, §9.1.8; K1 (b)): under I1 and `LayoutWF` (the clause `lwf` of
`Repr`), if an authority `a` has the effective mode `Modify` on a leaf `l`, no other authority `b`
has an effective mode on a leaf `l'` whose range overlaps the range of `l` (same allocation, ranges
not disjoint). The task asks it of the active authorities that do not descend from `a`; neither
condition is used: an active descendant of `a` covering `l` would remove the effective `Modify` of
`a` (MM-03.3.5), and an inactive authority has no effective mode. Memory justification of
non-aliasing, on the side of the kernel only. -/
theorem exclusive_bytes {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    (hI1 : I1 s3) {a b l l' : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hl' : l' < s3.P.length) (hlf' : isLeaf s3.P l') (ha : effective s3 a l = some .modify)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hsame : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc)
    (hover : ¬ MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) :
    effective s3 b l' = none := by
  by_cases e : l = l'
  · subst e; exact effective_exclusive hI1 hab ha
  · exact absurd (hlw.disjoint l hl l' hl' hlf hlf' e hsame) hover

`writeShared` included: they are data of the program, not a choice of the refinement. -/

import Ern.MM23
import Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-!
# MM23-H: adversarial corpus of the refinement (jalon 3, step 3)

The cases of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2), §3. Each case is an execution of
MM-03 from `S3.init statics` translated by `simulation` (`Ern.MM23`): an `SimRun` built step by step
by `srun`, which checks each labelled step (`Step3`) and its obligations (`Oblig`) by `decide`, with
parameters fixed once for the run. The layout is computed from the places of the run (`autoL`): the
`n`-th root place has the allocation `n` (MM-02 identities are created in that order, K2), its
leaves 8 bytes each in index order; the allocation of each root has 8 bytes per leaf, aligned on 8
(`autoG`); roots listed in `z` have size zero (K1 (d), D2). Tokens, placement, pointer encoding and
the obligations `dec` (accesses aligned on 4 bytes) are those of the pass-2 run `CaseSim`.

H15 and H16 rest on decisions 2 and 3 of jalon 2, not applied to the draft: they are encoded with
the verdict obtained and marked "écart connu" (material §0, rule 8). H14 and H17 are not encoded
(jalon-3 report, (a)).
-/

namespace Ern.MM23.Horrors

open Ern Ern.MM03 Ern.MM23

/-! ## Executable translated steps -/

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
the MM-02 state after the associated sequence (K4, L6). -/
def sexec (st : SSt) (op : Op3) : Option SSt :=
  match step3exec k st.1 op with
  | some s3' =>
    if Oblig k C ObR ObW π op st.1 s3' st.2.1 st.2.2 then
      some (s3', provStep op st.1 st.2.1, exec st.2.2 (assoc π op st.1 st.2.2))
    else none
  | none => none

/-- Translated run of a list of operations, in order of execution. -/
def srun (st : SSt) : List Op3 → Option SSt
  | [] => some st
  | op :: ops => (sexec k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

end Run

section RunSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
  {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)] {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
  {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} [∀ s o, Decidable (Op2.Dec ObR ObW s o)] {π : Params}
  {statics : Statics}

/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun`. -/
theorem srun_sound : ∀ {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
    {s2 : MM02.State} {ops' : List Op3} {st : SSt},
    SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → srun k C ObR ObW π (s3, pv, s2) ops' = some st →
    ∃ os', SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (ops'.reverse ++ ops) st.1 st.2.1 os' st.2.2
  | _, _, _, os, _, [], st, h, he => by
    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact ⟨os, h⟩
  | ops, s3, pv, os, s2, op :: ops', st, h, he => by
    simp only [srun] at he
    cases hx : sexec k C ObR ObW π (s3, pv, s2) op with
    | none => rw [hx] at he; cases he
    | some st₁ =>
      rw [hx] at he
      simp only [sexec] at hx
      cases hs : step3exec k s3 op with
      | none => rw [hs] at hx; cases hx
      | some s3' =>
        rw [hs] at hx
        simp only at hx
        split at hx
        · rename_i hob
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hx; subst hx
          obtain ⟨os', h2⟩ := srun_sound (h.step (step3exec_sound hs) hob) he
          exact ⟨os', by simpa [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc] using h2⟩
        · cases hx

theorem srun_append : ∀ (st : SSt) (ops ops' : List Op3),
    srun k C ObR ObW π st (ops ++ ops') =
      (srun k C ObR ObW π st ops).bind fun st' => srun k C ObR ObW π st' ops'
  | st, [], ops' => by simp [srun]
  | st, op :: ops, ops' => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, srun]
    cases sexec k C ObR ObW π st op with
    | none => rfl
    | some st₁ => simp only [Option.bind_some]; exact srun_append st₁ ops ops'

/-- A successful translated step is a labelled MM-03 step with its obligations. -/
theorem sexec_step {st st' : SSt} {op : Op3} (h : sexec k C ObR ObW π st op = some st') :
    ∃ s3', Step3 k op st.1 s3' ∧ Oblig k C ObR ObW π op st.1 s3' st.2.1 st.2.2 ∧
      st' = (s3', provStep op st.1 st.2.1, exec st.2.2 (assoc π op st.1 st.2.2)) := by
  simp only [sexec] at h
  cases hs : step3exec k st.1 op with
  | none => rw [hs] at h; cases h
  | some s3' =>
    rw [hs] at h
    simp only at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hob
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      exact ⟨s3', step3exec_sound hs, hob, h.symm⟩
    · cases h

end RunSound

/-! ## Parameters of the runs -/

/-- Root place of `q`: the last element of its chain of parents (MM-03.3.2). -/
def rootOf (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Nat := (chain (parentOf P) q).getLastD q

/-- Number of root places below `r`: the MM-02 identity of the allocation of the root `r` when every
root is laid out in its own allocation, in index order (K2). -/
def rootRank (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((List.range r).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ parentOf P i = none)).length

/-- Number of leaves of the root of `l` below `l`. -/
def leafRank (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((List.range l).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ isLeaf P i ∧ rootOf P i = rootOf P l)).length

/-- Layout of the runs (K1): a place in the allocation of its root, a leaf at 8 times its rank,
8 bytes; size zero for the roots of `z`. -/
def autoL (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Layout := fun q =>
  if rootOf P q ∈ z then ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 0, 0⟩
  else ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 8 * leafRank P q, 8⟩

/-- Geometry of the allocation of the root `r` (K2): 8 bytes per leaf, aligned on 8; size zero for
the roots of `z`. -/
def autoG (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Nat → Geom := fun r =>
  if r ∈ z then ⟨0, 0, 8⟩ else ⟨0, 8 * (footprint P r).length, 8⟩

/-- Compatibility by equality of tokens (`TokCompat`, as in `CaseSim`). -/
abbrev Ceq : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun a d => a = d

/-- Parameters of a run whose final places are `P` (`Params`): the layout and geometry above, the
tokens, placement, pointer encoding and bytes of `CaseSim`. -/
def piOf (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Params :=
  ⟨autoL P z, fun f => 100 + f, fun pr => 6 + pr, topPlacement, autoG P z, CaseSim.pe, CaseSim.w⟩

theorem piOf_geom (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) (r : Nat) :
    0 < ((piOf P z).geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 ((piOf P z).geom r).align := by
  simp only [piOf, autoG]
  split <;> exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos 7, ⟨3, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Initial state of a translation: `S3.init statics`, empty ghost, the MM-02 run of `repr_init`. -/
def sinit (statics : Statics) (π : Params) : SSt :=
  (S3.init statics, fun _ => none, exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))

/-- The MM-03 operation of a labelled one, the bytes of a write dropped. -/
def toOp : Op3 → Ern.HandlePool.Op
  | .derive src q m => .derive src q m
  | .split src rs => .split src rs
  | .release a => .release a
  | .transfer src dst => .transfer src dst
  | .depend q x => .depend q x
  | .enter ps ls => .enter ps ls
  | .exit => .exit
  | .read a ls => .read a ls
  | .write a ls _ => .write a ls
  | .writeShared a ls _ => .writeShared a ls
  | .pin p => .pin p
  | .unpin p => .unpin p
  | .endUse p => .endUse p
  | .free p auth => .free p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls => .alloc pr ow ls
  | .newArena st i => .newArena st i
  | .issue i via region dst => .issue i via region dst
  | .reset i via => .reset i via
  | .store a p => .store a p

/-- The state given for a translated run whose steps are not all `ok`: it has no frame, so it is not
reached (`sst_ok_of_reachable`). -/
def sstuck : SSt := ({ S3.init [] with F := [] }, fun _ => none, MM02.State.empty)

section Cases
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- The state reached by the translated run of `ops`; `sstuck` if a step is not `ok`, so a statement
that its MM-03 state is reached says that every step is `ok` (`sst_ok_of_reachable`). -/
def sst (statics : Statics) (π : Params) (ops : List Op3) : SSt :=
  (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD sstuck

end Cases

section Sim
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A successful translated run from the initial state is a `SimRun`. -/
theorem simRun_of {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {ops : List Op3}
    (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)))
    (hlay : NewLayout (piOf P z).L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 (piOf P z).geom
      (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
    (hdec : DecAlong CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf (piOf P z) statics))
    (h : (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z)) ops).isSome =
      true) :
    ∃ os, SimRun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW statics (piOf P z) ops.reverse
      (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).1 (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.1 os
      (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.2 := by
  obtain ⟨os, h'⟩ := srun_sound (SimRun.init (k := k) (C := Ceq) hsh hlay hdec)
    (Ern.HandlePool.some_getD (d := sstuck) h)
  rw [List.append_nil] at h'
  exact ⟨os, h'⟩

/-- `simulation` on a translated run: the MM-02 run from `State.empty` has only `ok` outcomes,
reaches the MM-02 state of the run, which is in `Repr` with the MM-03 state, reached. -/
    ∀ r r', KLf.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → (∀ l ∈ r, l < r4d.1.P.length ∧ isLeaf r4d.1.P l) →
      (∀ l ∈ r', l < r4d.1.P.length ∧ isLeaf r4d.1.P l) → ByteDisjoint π4.L r r' := by
  obtain ⟨os, hok, -, hR, -⟩ := sim_of (k := KLf) (statics := []) (P := P4) (z := [])
    (ops := r4 ++ [.split 0 [[1], [2]]]) KLf_dd (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  exact ⟨KLf_dd, by decide, .reject (by decide), by decide, .ok (by decide), ⟨os, hok, hR⟩,
    fun r r' hd hr hr' => byteDisjoint_of_leaves hR.lwf hr hr' hd⟩

/-! ## Run R5: pointers to empty regions (H15, écart connu) -/

/-- R5: frame 1 with the arena value 0, the allocator 1, the leaves 2, 3, 4; storage 5 with the
leaf 6, owned by 0, `internal` 5; `issue []` to 2; `split` of the root of 3 into `[[]]`, then
`store` of that empty authority 7 into 4. -/
def r5 : List Op3 := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1] w,
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 5, none, 0)], .write 0 [0] w, .newArena 5 5, .issue 0 0 [] 2,
  .split 3 [[]], .store 7 4]
def P5 : List Place := (Ern.MM03.Horrors.run K0 [] (r5.map toOp)).s.P
def π5 : Params := piOf P5 []
def r5f : SSt := sst K0 [] π5 r5

/-- Base address of the allocation `i` in `s2`. -/
def baseOf (s2 : MM02.State) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((s2.allocs i).map (·.base)).getD 0

/-- Address decoded from the range of the leaf `l` (L6, the encoding of the run). -/
def decodedAt (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Nat := CaseSim.pe.decode (bytesOf s2 L l)

/-- **MM23-H15**, écart connu (material §0, rule 8; decision 2 of jalon 2 not applied). Expected: the
pointer to an empty region has as address the base of the allocation of its effective anchor and
as provenance that allocation. Obtained in a translated run: `issue []` writes the address 0, with
the provenance of the storage of the arena (the allocation of the anchor `internal` 5); the `store`
of an empty region split from the root of 3 writes the address 0 without provenance. The bases of
those allocations are not 0. Not presented as passed. -/
theorem H15 : (∃ os, AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty os ∧
      Repr π5.tok π5.ptok r5f.2.1 π5.L r5f.1 r5f.2.2) ∧
    decodedAt r5f.2.2 π5.L 2 = 0 ∧ (bytesOf r5f.2.2 π5.L 2 0).2 = some (π5.L 5).alloc ∧
    baseOf r5f.2.2 (π5.L 5).alloc ≠ 0 ∧
    decodedAt r5f.2.2 π5.L 4 = 0 ∧ (bytesOf r5f.2.2 π5.L 4 0).2 = none ∧
    baseOf r5f.2.2 (π5.L 3).alloc ≠ 0 :=
  ⟨(sim_of (P := P5) (z := []) (KT_dd _ _ _ _ _) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide)).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2.1⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ## Run R6: a region whose head has not the lowest offset (H16, écart connu) -/

/-- R6: frame 1 with the arena value 0, the allocator 1, the leaf 2; storage 3 with the leaves 4
(offset 0) and 5 (offset 8); `issue [5, 4]` to 2. -/
def r6 : List Op3 := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1] w,
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)], .write 0 [0] w, .newArena 3 3,
  .issue 0 0 [5, 4] 2]
def P6 : List Place := (Ern.MM03.Horrors.run K0 [] (r6.map toOp)).s.P
def π6 : Params := piOf P6 []
def r6f : SSt := sst K0 [] π6 r6

/-- **MM23-H16**, écart connu (material §0, rule 8; decision 3 of jalon 2 not applied). Expected: the
pointer to the region `[5, 4]` has the lowest address of its non-empty leaves, that of 4. Obtained
in a translated run: the address of the head 5, 8 bytes above. Not presented as passed. -/
theorem H16 : (∃ os, AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty os ∧
      Repr π6.tok π6.ptok r6f.2.1 π6.L r6f.1 r6f.2.2) ∧
    (π6.L 4).off = 0 ∧ (π6.L 5).off = 8 ∧
    decodedAt r6f.2.2 π6.L 2 = baseOf r6f.2.2 (π6.L 3).alloc + 8 ∧
    decodedAt r6f.2.2 π6.L 2 ≠ baseOf r6f.2.2 (π6.L 3).alloc :=
  ⟨(sim_of (P := P6) (z := []) (KT_dd _ _ _ _ _) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide)).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2.1⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ## Run R7 and `fail`: `alloc` of size zero and failed (H07) -/

/-- R7: frame 1 with the allocator 0 and `x` (1), written; the storage 2 allocated for `x`, laid out
with size zero (K1 (d), D2: a shape of one leaf). -/
def r7 : List Op3 := [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0] w, .write 1 [1] w, .alloc 0 1 [lf]]
def P7 : List Place := (Ern.MM03.Horrors.run K0 [] (r7.map toOp)).s.P
def π7 : Params := piOf P7 [2]
def r7a : SSt := sst K0 [] π7 (r7.take 3)

instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (KNS.DeclaredDisjoint r r') := fun _ _ => instDecidableFalse
instance : DecidablePred KNS.Pinned := fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ ([] : List Nat)))
instance : DecidablePred KNS.ExternalDone := fun l =>
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ ([] : List Nat)))
instance : DecidablePred KNS.Deallocable := fun l =>
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ ([] : List Nat)))
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (KNS.FreeCompat p a) := fun p a =>
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((p, a) ∈ ([] : List (Nat × Nat))))

/-- The prefix of R7 reached under the contracts `KNS`, where no allocation is satisfiable. -/
def r7n : Ern.HandlePool.PS := Ern.MM03.Horrors.run KNS [] ((r7.take 3).map toOp)

/-- **MM23-H07** (passe 1). `alloc` `ok`: one allocation of MM-02, `ok` (R1, `H07_ok`); of size zero:
one allocation of size 0, `ok` (`step_ok_of`) in a translated run; `fail` (`K.Satisfiable` false,

(`Step3` asks the outcome `ok`), so the translation has no step and no MM-02 operation. Expected:

theorem H07 : (∃ os, AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty os ∧
      exec MM02.State.empty os = (sst K0 [] π7 r7).2.2) ∧
    (assoc π7 (.alloc 0 1 [lf]) r7a.1 r7a.2.2).map opAllocSize = [some 0] ∧
    AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW r7a.2.2 (assoc π7 (.alloc 0 1 [lf]) r7a.1 r7a.2.2) ∧
    Ern.HandlePool.PReach KNS [] r7n ∧ AllocStep KNS 0 1 [lf] r7n.s (.fail r7n.s) ∧
    ∀ s', ¬ Step3 KNS (.alloc 0 1 [lf]) r7n.s s' :=
  ⟨(sim_of (P := P7) (z := [2]) (KT_dd _ _ _ _ _) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide)).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩, by decide,
    step_ok_of (k := K0) (statics := []) (P := P7) (z := [2]) (ops := r7.take 3)
      (op := .alloc 0 1 [lf]) (KT_dd [] [] [] [] [])
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
    Ern.MM03.Horrors.run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .fail (by decide) (fun h => h),
    fun _ hs => nomatch alloc_det hs.2 (AllocStep.fail (by decide) (fun h => h))⟩

# Formalization design

Decisions for the Lean formalization. They govern how to formalize, never what ERN means: semantics comes only from `specs/`. Agents follow them. A design question not settled here is proposed in the report, never decided silently.

## Goal

Check that the spec's rules deliver what ERN promises. A rule that cannot be formalized or proven as written is a result: report it with the failing goal, never work around it.

Three results stay distinct: the formal model of the rules, the theorems proven about that model, and later the correctness of the compiler against it. This formalization covers the first two.

## Architecture

The formalization uses two permanent, complementary models linked
by a refinement theorem.

This is an architectural decision about formalization, not a
normative decision about ERN semantics. Both models must faithfully
represent the validated specifications.

If a specification cannot be represented faithfully, the mismatch
must be reported. Any necessary change to the formalization
architecture requires an explicit revision of this document.

1. **Abstract model.** Memory is a set of places: variables and field paths (`p.right`). Gives the semantics of safe code. States what safe code may assume about memory.
2. **Concrete model.** Memory is byte-addressed allocations. Gives the semantics of safe and unsafe code. Parameterized by a layout interface, never by a fixed layout.
3. **Refinement theorem.** Links the two models. It is the formal statement of ERN's safety promise.

## Concrete memory

- Bytes are abstract: each byte carries its initialization state and, when it belongs to a pointer, its provenance. Address and provenance are distinct.
- The concrete model represents every distinction the spec's rules rely on, including storage shared by several places.

## Layout interface

- Size, alignment and position of each component of a type are abstract functions.
- Their guarantees (in bounds, non-overlapping where the spec requires it, aligned) are hypotheses carried as structure fields or typeclass assumptions, never Lean `axiom`s.
- The interface contains only guarantees that some spec rule needs. Each hypothesis cites the rule that requires it.
- Non-vacuity: whenever the interface changes, a layout satisfying it is exhibited and proven. An unsatisfiable interface would make every refinement result empty.
- Realizability for every admissible target and instance is an obligation of the charter's ABI and layout step. It stays recorded as open until that step discharges it.

## Main theorems

- **Observable behaviors** are defined explicitly: termination with its observable result, trap, undefined behavior, divergence. Refinement compares concrete behaviors projected onto abstract observations.
- **Abstract safety.** A program accepted by the static rules has no undefined behavior in the abstract model.
- **Refinement.** For every layout satisfying the interface: if each unsafe region satisfies its contract, every observable behavior of an accepted program in the concrete model projects to a behavior of the abstract model. Concrete safety follows from abstract safety.
- **Unsafe contracts.** A contract is an entry condition and an exit condition relating the two models. From any state satisfying the entry condition, no execution of the region reaches undefined behavior, and every non-trap exit satisfies the exit condition. A trap is terminal: it runs no cleanup and is compared as an observable behavior. The relation between the models implies the entry condition of any region reachable from safe code; a stronger entry condition must be established by the unsafe code that enters the region. Intermediate states may break the relation, since in sequential execution no other code observes them. Under concurrency, shared state is observable during the region; the contract form for that case is decided before milestone 4.
- **Scope.** Every theorem states the language fragment it covers. A theorem on a fragment supports no claim about the whole language; sequential safety implies nothing about concurrent safety.

## Construction order

1. Control flow infrastructure: abstract syntax and operational semantics of control constructs. No safety theorem yet: the control flow spec's preservation rule depends on the memory and concurrency models.
2. Memory model, safe part, on the abstract model. Abstract safety for the sequential fragment.
3. Concrete model, layout interface and refinement for the sequential fragment. The memory model counts as verified for that fragment only once refinement is proven.
4. Concurrency model: extends both models and the refinement.
5. IR dialect, once its dependencies are formalized.

The semantic style of milestones 4 and 5 and their target theorems are decided here before they start.

## Representation

- **Abstract syntax** is built incrementally: only the constructs required by the rules being formalized. No concrete syntax.
- **Semantics** is a step function where the spec is deterministic, a step relation where it is not. Interpreters for tests iterate steps with fuel. Running out of fuel is not an outcome, neither termination nor trap. Each interpreter is proven to agree with the unbounded semantics on every result it returns.
- **No Mathlib** unless a milestone requires it. Adding it is a design decision recorded here.

/-! ## Chains (§40, §42, §49) -/

/-- A chain from an element without link is empty (§40 parents, §42 origins). -/
theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
  | 0 => rfl
  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]

/-- Any fuel at least the start index gives the same chain (§40, §42; acyclicity, §49). -/
theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
    ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [chainF]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
      · rfl
    · rfl

/-- The chain of an element without link is empty (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) : chain org i = [] :=
  chainF_none h i

/-- The chain of `i` is its link followed by the chain of the link (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_cons {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i o : Nat} (h : org i = some o) (hlt : o < i) :
    chain org i = o :: chain org o := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [chain, chainF, h, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [chainF_fuel org k o o (by omega) (Nat.le_refl o)]

/-- Elements of a chain are below its start (§49, acyclic chains). -/
theorem chainF_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i j, j ∈ chainF org k i → j < i
  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, j, h => by
    simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
    · split at h
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
        · assumption
        · exact Nat.lt_trans (chainF_lt k _ j h) ‹_›
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- Every element of a chain is below its start (§49, acyclic chains). -/
theorem chain_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i j : Nat} (h : j ∈ chain org i) : j < i :=
  chainF_lt i i j h

/-- A chain within fuel `k` has at most `k` elements (§49, finite chains). -/
theorem chainF_length {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i, (chainF org k i).length ≤ k
  | 0, _ => by simp [chainF]
  | k + 1, i => by
    simp only [chainF]; split
    · split
      · simp only [List.length_cons]; have := chainF_length (org := org) k ‹_›; omega
      · simp
    · simp

/-- A chain from `i` has at most `i` elements (§49, finite chains). -/
theorem chain_length (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : (chain org i).length ≤ i :=
  chainF_length i i

/-- A chain depends only on the links at or below its start (§40, §42). -/
theorem chainF_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} :
    ∀ k i, (∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) → chainF org k i = chainF org' k i
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, i, h => by
    simp only [chainF]; rw [h i (Nat.le_refl i)]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_congr k _ fun j hj => h j (by omega)]
      · rfl
    · rfl

/-- A chain depends only on the links at or below its start (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : ∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) :
    chain org i = chain org' i := chainF_congr i i h

/-- Two elements without link of one chain are equal (§40 root places, §49.5 root
authorities). -/
theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →
    r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
    simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
    · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
      split at h
      · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
        · rfl
        · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
        · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- A chain contains the chain of each of its elements, for links to smaller indices (§40, §42,
§49). -/
theorem chain_trans {org : Nat → Option Nat} (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ r, r ∈ chain org i → ∀ o ∈ chain org r, o ∈ chain org i
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hi, r, hr, o, ho => by
    cases hp : org i with
    | none => rw [chain_none hp] at hr; simp at hr
    | some p =>
      have hpi := hlt i p hp
      rw [chain_cons hp hpi] at hr ⊢
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (chain_trans hlt n p (by omega) r hr o ho)

theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by
  simp [kids, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

/-- A place has no children exactly when it is a leaf (§40, §63.2). -/
theorem kids_nil_iff {P : List Place} {l : Nat} : kids P l = [] ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h r hr hp
    have : r ∈ kids P l := mem_kids.2 ⟨hr, hp⟩
    rw [h] at this; simp at this
  · intro h
    exact nil_of_forall_not_mem fun r hr => by
      obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := mem_kids.1 hr; exact h r hr hp

/-- Any fuel at least the index gives the same `corr` (§63.2). -/
theorem corrF_fuel (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) :
    ∀ n m r, r ≤ n → r ≤ m → corrF P src dst n r = corrF P src dst m r
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, m + 1, r, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, 0, r, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, m + 1, r, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n m _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        · rfl
      · rfl

/-- `corr(src) = dst` (§63.2). -/
theorem corr_src (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : corr P src dst src = some dst := by
  unfold corr; cases src <;> simp [corrF]

/-- `corr(r)` for a part other than `src`: the child at the position of `r` among the children
of its parent, under the place corresponding to that parent (§63.2). -/
theorem corr_step {P : List Place} {src dst r p : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src)
    (hp : parentOf P r = some p) (hlt : p < r) :
    corr P src dst r = (corr P src dst p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, r = n + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  unfold corr
  simp only [corrF, hr, ↓reduceIte, hp, hlt]
  rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n p _ (by omega) (Nat.le_refl p)]

/-- An element found at an index belongs to the list (§63.2). -/
theorem getElem?_mem {l : List Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : l[i]? = some x) : x ∈ l :=
  List.mem_of_getElem? h

/-- The place corresponding to a part of `src` is a part of `dst` (§63.2). -/
theorem corr_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) :
    ∀ n r r', r < n → corr s.P src dst r = some r' → partOf s.P r' dst
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, r', hr, h => by
    by_cases e : r = src
    · subst e; rw [corr_src] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hd, .inl rfl⟩
    cases hp : parentOf s.P r with
    | none =>
      unfold corr at h
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [corrF, e] at h
      | succ m => simp [corrF, e, hp] at h
    | some p =>
      have hlt := (hw.parent_lt hp).1
      rw [corr_step e hp hlt] at h
      cases hc : corr s.P src dst p with
      | none => rw [hc] at h; cases h
      | some p' =>
        rw [hc] at h; simp only [Option.bind_some] at h
        have ih := corr_partOf hw hd n p p' (by omega) hc
        obtain ⟨hr'l, hr'p⟩ := mem_kids.1 (getElem?_mem h)
        have hlt' := (hw.parent_lt hr'p).1
        refine ⟨hr'l, .inr ?_⟩
        rw [chain_cons hr'p hlt']
        rcases ih.2 with rfl | hc'
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc'

/-- A holder within `src` moves to a part of `dst` (§63, `ok` effect). -/
theorem mvTo_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) {h : Holder}
    (hh : heldIn s.P src h) : ∃ r', mvTo s.P src dst h = .place r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hh.elim
  | place r =>
    cases hc : corr s.P src dst r with
    | none => exact ⟨dst, by simp [mvTo, hc], hd, .inl rfl⟩
    | some r' =>
      exact ⟨r', by simp [mvTo, hc], corr_partOf hw hd (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc⟩
